page.cmpCtaTitle: Easier to try than to compare.
page.cmpCtaDescription: One install, five minutes — first workflow running on your machine.
page.cmpHeroDescription: We're not for everyone — and we're upfront about that. Here's a concrete breakdown of each alternative, including cases where the right answer is something else.
page.cmpMetaDesc: How KB Labs compares to GitHub Actions, n8n, Temporal, and AI agents.

cmpObjections.q: We're already on GitHub Actions — why switch?
cmpObjections.a: You don't have to switch. KB Labs handles what CI/CD doesn't — review gates, AI orchestration, QA trends, agent workflows. Run it beside Actions.

cmpObjections.q: Is this just another workflow tool?
cmpObjections.a: No. KB Labs is a runtime with a permissions model, an extension system, and observability built in. Workflows are one capability, not the whole product.
One-command install. First workflow in under an hour. The complexity scales with your team, not the other way around.
Self-hosted by default. Nothing leaves your network unless you explicitly route it. No telemetry, no analytics, no cloud backend owned by anyone else.

cmpObjections.q: We don't have a dedicated DevOps person.
cmpObjections.a: KB Labs is designed for engineers who own their own infra. The CLI is the primary interface. No GUI required, no YAML wizards.
As first-class workflow steps with typed contracts and permission enforcement. The same runtime governs humans, bots, and agents.

rows.feature: AI steps out of the box

cmpAlternatives.label: GitHub Actions / GitLab CI
cmpAlternatives.verdict: Great for build and deploy. Not designed for developer tooling.
good: Handles build and deploy pipelines well
kb: Runs on your infra — secrets never leave your network
Covers what CI/CD ignores: review gates, QA trends, agent workflows
Works beside Actions, not instead of it

cmpAlternatives.label: n8n / Make / Zapier
cmpAlternatives.verdict: Fast to start. Hard to maintain at engineering scale.
kb: Workflows are code — reviewable, testable, version-controlled
Typed plugin contracts replace GUI nodes

cmpAlternatives.label: Temporal / Prefect / Airflow
cmpAlternatives.verdict: Excellent for distributed systems. KB Labs solves a different problem.
good: Built for data pipelines and long-running jobs
kb: Designed for development teams, not data engineers
No distributed systems infrastructure to operate
Covers code review, release, QA — not data pipelines
cmpAlternatives.note: Different tools for different problems. We complement, not compete.

cmpAlternatives.label: Custom internal tools
cmpAlternatives.verdict: You own the code. You also own every bug and upgrade.
good: Fully custom to your exact requirements
No external dependencies or vendor risk
kb: Open source — fork it, own it, no vendor lock-in
Plugin SDK means you extend without maintaining core
